@roderickgraham @wil_da_beast630 Can it be used as a way to dismiss? Sure. No one likes being told that their problems aren't real (exaggerated would be better). People also don't like being told that they're complicit or racist when they're not.

As such, #AllLivesMatter is a reaction to #BlackLivesMatter.
